items.exampleEn: Our hostel was clean but very noisy.
items.exampleZh: 我們住的青年旅館很乾淨，但很吵。

items.exampleEn: They spent a week on a small isle near the coast.
items.exampleZh: 他們在靠近海岸的一座小島上待了一週。

items.exampleEn: The signpost says the village is two kilometers away.
items.exampleZh: 路標上寫著村子在兩公里外。

items.exampleEn: We walked out to the ness to watch the sea.
She often cooks dishes from her motherland.
The Atlantic Ocean is very cold in the north.
The fire station is next to the police station.
items.exampleZh: 消防局就在警察局隔壁。

items.exampleEn: She was chosen as vice president of the student club.
items.exampleZh: 她被選為學生社團的副社長。

items.sentenceEn: Follow the signpost to the beach.

items.audioEn: The youth hostel has free breakfast, but towels cost two dollars.
items.audioZh: 這家青年旅館提供免費早餐，但毛巾要兩元。

items.sentenceEn: My uncle has worked at the fire station for ten years.
items.sentenceZh: 我叔叔在消防局工作十年了。

items.sentenceEn: The vice president will speak at the meeting tomorrow.
items.sentenceZh: 副總裁明天會在會議上發言。

items.stemEn: Many young travelers stay in a ____ because it is cheap.
items.stemZh: 許多年輕旅客住青年旅館，因為很便宜。

items.stemEn: There are no cars on the small ____, so people get around by boat or bike.
items.stemZh: 那座小島上沒有汽車，所以大家靠船或腳踏車移動。

items.passageEn: Last summer, I traveled along the Atlantic coast for two weeks. I slept in cheap hostels and met people from many countries. One morning, I followed a signpost to a ness, where I could see a small isle in the distance. When I couldn't find my hostel, the firefighters at the local fire station showed me the way. I also sent a package of postcards home to my grandfather. He was born near this coast but moved abroad when he was young, and he still misses his motherland.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我沿著大西洋海岸旅行了兩個星期。我住便宜的青年旅館，認識了來自許多國家的人。有一天早上，我跟著路標走到一個海角，從那裡可以看到遠處的一座小島。我找不到青年旅館時，當地消防局的消防員為我指了路。我也寄了一包明信片回家給爺爺。他在這片海岸附近出生，年輕時搬到國外，至今仍想念他的故鄉。

questions.questionZh: 作者在海角看到了什麼？
作者找不到青年旅館時，誰幫了忙？

items.promptZh: 她在國外住了三十年後回到故鄉。
referenceEn: She returned to her motherland after thirty years abroad.
After living abroad for thirty years, she went back to her motherland.
rubricZh: 「回到」可寫，例如 return to、go back to 等
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.promptZh: 我們公司的副總裁以前是一名老師。
referenceEn: The vice president of our company used to be a teacher.
Our company's vice president was once a teacher.
rubricZh: 用 vice president 表示「副總裁」
「以前是」可寫，例如 used to be、was once 等
